Just a simple plugin to do your macro with a hotkey instead of hotbar. # HotKeyIt Just a simple plugin to do your macro with a hotkey instead of hotbar. # Installation Add
``` https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tigurand/DalamudPlugins/refs/heads/main/repo.json ``` to list of custom repo under Experimental tab in dalamud settings. Install and enable HotKeyIt.
